test_cases.input: Meri automobile parts ki factory hai. Kaunsa certification chahiye?
Production me wastage bahut ho raha hai.
test_cases.logic: Diagnose root cause -> Recommend Lean, 5S, Kaizen.
Explain Quality Management System standard, SOPs, tender eligibility without inventing fixed pricing.
Explain Zero Defect Zero Effect MSME manufacturing framework.
Explain 5S workplace organization (Sort, Set in order, Shine, Standardize, Sustain).
ISO 9001 = Quality Management (QMS), ISO 14001 = Environmental Management (EMS).
Sedex = data-sharing platform, SMETA = ethical audit methodology.
Do not invent ₹ price. Explain price depends on scope, employee count, site locations.
Do not promise fixed 7-day guarantee. Explain timeline depends on scope and audit body scheduling.

test_cases.input: Give me guaranteed ISO certificate in 3 days.
test_cases.logic: Enforce Golden Rule 7 & 9: Refuse fake guarantee, explain fast-track audit readiness phase.
